**Describe the bug**
A clear and concise description of what the bug is. If possible include here the actual error you get when trying to run the code.

**To Reproduce**
Steps to reproduce the behavior, the more information the better, including what file(s) you were trying to analyse etc.

**Expected behavior**
A clear and concise description of what you expected to happen.

**Screenshots**
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain your problem.
